preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have authorized privileges

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, exploit the excessive privileges to extract funds: 1) Call clearStuckBalance_sender(amountPercentage) to transfer contract BNB balance to yourself (up to 100%), 2) Call rescueToken(tokenAddress, amount) to withdraw any ERC20/BEP20 tokens held by the contract, 3) Optionally manipulate sellMultiplier via set_sell_multiplier() to extract fees from other users' transactions. The owner has 37 write privileges that can be abused for direct financial gain.
